what_happened.line: The task force went through a consultant's streetlight LED proposal with him by phone, and agreed to drop the pilot-related item and its amount.
Item seven was reworded so the consultant helps write an RFP that includes maintenance, with multi-year maintenance left open by mutual agreement.
The consultant is to proceed with the report work, aiming to finish before the 28th, with the RFP going out in January.
The chair will tell the consultant the on-site visit should fall in the week between Christmas and New Year's.
A true-up found more streetlights than the town had been paying for, and fixture counts were corrected several times; no vote was recorded.

why_it_matters: Streetlight billing and a future LED conversion affect the town's electric costs, and a true-up that finds more lights than were being paid for can change what the town owes the utility.
The RFP and any maintenance contract will determine who pays for upkeep of the lights, and for how many years, once they are converted.
